plugins.name: management-portal
plugins.description: Operate the management-portal MCP with the full agent discipline - the core loop, the three gates (read-after-write, completeness, task-breakdown), bottom-up completion, never-fabricate-ids, and board-first. Sign in with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE on first use, so there is no API key to paste, copy or store (an API key is still accepted on X-API-Key for headless and CI clients that cannot open a browser). Bundles the MCP server, the management-portal and team-chat-reachability skills, the canon-gates reference, the portal-operator and team-chat-watcher subagents, and the /portal and /rearm-watch commands. What actually enforces, stated plainly: the Team Chat turn-end ABSENT gate returns decision:block and is verified to refuse to end a turn; the read-after-write hook injects text only and has never been able to refuse anything. The canon gates - PreToolUse denials for fabricated ids and out-of-order writes, the debt gates, and the stand-down escape - are designed and fixture-tested but do NOT ship in this release; see management-portal/skills/management-portal/canon-gates.md for the status board.
